text:
Ana: Quick poll — pick a webinar angle by noon: 1) Tech deep-dive (engineers) 2) Customer playbook (PMs + execs) 3) Hybrid (compact tech + biz takeaways). Thoughts?

Mei: Hybrid wins for me. We get attendance breadth and can split promo copy.

Jake: Hybrid too. Marketing can segment emails to two audiences.

Sam: Scheduling note: pick a time that hits NA + EMEA overlap. I can do captioning + recording.

Marco: For demo, plan deterministic inputs and a recorded backup. I'll script a forced-fallback scenario so the failover is repeatable.

Lina: Lead flow: form boolean `demo_ok`. If true -> tag `webinar:demo` and push to AE rotation. Also capture timezone.

Ana: Abstract draft: 'Practical inference playbook: how teams cut latency and token cost in production. Live demo, benchmark takeaways, and customer lessons.' Short and customer-facing.

Mei: I'll produce a one-pager benchmark and a short hero visual. Jake can reuse for social.

Jake: I'll draft landing H1: 'Serve LLMs Faster & Cheaper — Ops tricks that actually move the needle.' Will make two subject lines for A/B test.

Sam: Rehearsal plan: caption test (20m), tech check (30m), full dress (45m). Ops-bot will propose slots.

ops-bot: ops-bot: suggested slots posted to organizers channel.

Ana: Run-of-show quick draft:
- 0-5m intro + housekeeping
- 5-15m benchmark story
- 15-35m demo + explainers
- 35-50m customer case + lessons
- 50-60m Q&A + CTA

Marco: I'll upload demo assets and backup to GDrive and keep a local copy.

Lina: SDRs will triage leads within 48hrs. I'll post AE outreach template after Mei confirms CTA language.

Ana: Action items: Mei hero + one-pager; Marco demo + backup; Jake landing + emails; Sam book rehearsals; Lina configure routing. Confirm by EOD. :thumbsup:
